about.contact.account.description: Term before the account of this server to contact about the server, on the server's information page.

about.contact.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with how to reach the server's operators.

about.status.description.defaultMessage: The operators tell of outages and maintenance of this server on its status page, which stays reachable when this server does not answer.
about.status.description.description: Paragraph in the server status section of the server's information page: what the status page is for.

about.status.link.description: Link to the server's status page, on another site, on the server's information page. The link leaves the app.

about.description.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with the server's description.

about.domains.empty.description: Shown in place of the list of moderated servers when there are none.

about.domains.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the list of moderated servers when it could not be loaded.

about.domains.intro.defaultMessage: This server limits or suspends federation with these servers.
about.domains.intro.description: Explanation under the heading of the list of moderated servers on the server's information page.

about.domains.kind.limit.defaultMessage: Limited: its posts stay off the public timelines
about.domains.kind.limit.description: Next to a server in the list of moderated servers: its posts stay off the public timelines and its accounts reach only their followers.

about.domains.kind.suspend.description: Next to a server in the list of moderated servers: this server does not federate with it at all.

about.domains.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while the list of moderated servers loads.

about.domains.more.description: Button under the list of moderated servers that loads more of them.

about.domains.more_failed.description: Shown under the list of moderated servers when its next page could not be loaded.

about.domains.obfuscated.defaultMessage: Some server names are partly hidden with *.
about.domains.obfuscated.description: Note above the list of moderated servers when the moderators hid part of some servers' names.

about.domains.retry.description: Button that tries again to load the list of moderated servers after a failure.

about.domains.sign_in.description: Link after the note that only signed-in users can see the list of moderated servers; it opens the sign-in screen.

about.domains.signed_in_only.defaultMessage: Only signed-in users can see this list.
about.domains.signed_in_only.description: Shown in place of the list of moderated servers to a visitor who is not signed in, when the server shows it to signed-in users only.

about.domains.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that lists the other servers whose federation this server limits or suspends.

about.crawlers.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that says what the server states to search engines and AI crawlers.

about.crawlers.search.defaultMessage: {setting, select, allow {Search engines may index the profiles and public posts of the accounts that allow it.} other {This server asks search engines not to index any of its pages.}}
about.crawlers.search.description: What the server states to search engines, by the server setting search_indexing (allow or deny).

about.crawlers.ai.defaultMessage: {setting, select, allow {This server reserves nothing against AI: AI may train on and use its pages, except those of the accounts that opt out.} deny_training {This server reserves its pages against the training of AI models. AI search and assistants may still use them, except the pages of the accounts that opt out.} other {This server reserves its pages against the training of AI models and against their use by AI search, assistants and agents.}}
about.crawlers.ai.description: What the server states to AI crawlers, by the server setting ai_usage (allow, deny_training, or deny).

about.crawlers.how.defaultMessage: The server states this in its robots.txt (with a list of known AI crawlers), in the robots meta tag and the X-Robots-Tag, Content-Usage and tdm-reservation headers of its pages, and in /.well-known/tdmrep.json. These are requests: well-known crawlers say they follow some of them, but nothing technically stops a crawler that does not.
about.crawlers.how.description: How the server states its search and AI settings: the machine-readable means it uses.

about.crawlers.accounts.defaultMessage: Each account can also keep its profile and posts out of search engines, or deny AI, for its own pages on this server. An account cannot allow what the server denies. Media files and copies of posts on other servers do not carry an account's choice.
about.crawlers.accounts.description: That each account can narrow the server's statement for its own pages, but never widen it.

about.crawlers.legal.defaultMessage: What such a statement means in law depends on the country. In the EU, it is meant as a machine-readable reservation of rights against text and data mining under Article 4(3) of the Directive on Copyright in the Digital Single Market. In Japan, Article 30-4 of the Copyright Act allows many uses for data analysis without permission, so the statement may not bind them legally; many operators still follow such statements voluntarily. This page is not legal advice.
about.crawlers.legal.description: The legal positioning of the server's AI statement: Japan's Copyright Act Article 30-4 and the EU DSM Directive Article 4. Must not promise a legal effect.

about.costs.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page about what running the server costs, shown when the server publishes its costs.

about.costs.description.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, breakdown {This server publishes what it costs to run by week, month, and year, with a breakdown by provider and category. The names of the items, their notes, and the individual payments are not published.} other {This server publishes the totals of what it costs to run by week, month, and year. What they are spent on, the names of the items, and the individual payments are not published.}}
about.costs.description.description: What the server publishes of its running costs, by the server setting finance_visibility (totals or breakdown).

about.income.description.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, plans {This server publishes its income from its supporters by week, month, and year, after the payment provider's fees and refunds, and how many members each plan has now. Who paid and how much each paid are not published.} other {This server publishes the totals of its income from its supporters by week, month, and year, after the payment provider's fees and refunds. Who paid and how much each paid are not published.}}
about.income.description.description: What the server publishes of its income from the supporter plans, by the server setting income_visibility (totals or plans).

about.income.balance.defaultMessage: It also publishes the balance: the income less the costs.
about.income.balance.description: Note on the server's information page that the balance (income less costs) is published, shown when both the costs and the income are published.

about.costs.link.defaultMessage: {shown, select, both {See the running costs and income} income {See the income} other {See the running costs}}
about.costs.link.description: Link from the server's information page to the page of the server's running costs and income, by what the server publishes: both, the income only, or the costs only.

about.commerce.title.description: Heading of the section of the information page that links to the server's page of the commerce disclosures of its supporter plans (ADR-0072 §13).

about.commerce.link.description: Link from the information page to the server's page of the commerce disclosures of its supporter plans.

about.licenses.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that links to the license notices of the third-party software, data and fonts that the web app bundles.

about.licenses.intro.defaultMessage: The web app bundles software, data and fonts made by others, each under its own license; their license notices follow.
about.licenses.intro.description: Paragraph before the list of links to the license notices of the third-party software, data and fonts that the web app bundles, on the server's information page.

about.licenses.npm.description: Link to the plain-text license notices of the npm packages bundled into the web app's code, on the server's information page.

about.licenses.npm_sw.defaultMessage: npm packages in the offline support (Service Worker)
about.licenses.npm_sw.description: Link to the plain-text license notices of the npm packages bundled into the web app's Service Worker, which keeps the app working offline, on the server's information page.

about.licenses.unicode.defaultMessage: Unicode emoji data and CLDR emoji names (Unicode License v3)

about.licenses.noto.defaultMessage: Noto Color Emoji font (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
about.licenses.noto.description: Link to the plain-text SIL Open Font License 1.1, under which the Noto Color Emoji font that draws emoji is distributed, on the server's information page. Keep 'Noto Color Emoji' and 'SIL Open Font License 1.1' as they are.

about.rules.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page with the server's rules.

about.source.title.description: Heading of the section of the server's information page that tells where to get the source code of the server's software.

about.source.license.description: Paragraph in the source code section of the server's information page: the license of the server's software and the right of its users to get the source code.
